Totum is a uniquely structured multi-disciplinary firm of designers, architects, construction & project managers committed to changing the way design and construction are delivered both to client and the environment through our 'client partner' approach. Totum Design Development is dedicated to redefining the design process and is committed to the belief that architecture in its most noble aspiration is crafted from the careful management of intents and expectations in concert with the physical, financial, and legal realities of building without compromise to design's potential.
We are seeking a competent junior to intermediate level architectural designer with at least a couple of years experience with strong contemporary design & graphic skills. While our design assignments are informed by our collective experience, our design approach fully recognizes the potential for design to elevate and bring value to clients and end users. We are currently working in the institutional, residential, healthcare, and commercial tenant improvement sectors.
Our unique ways & our wide range of services regularly bring added value to all services through the overlap of the different market segments we work in. As such, the position is best suited for a self motivated Los Angeles professional seeking professional growth. The candidate must be proficient in AutoCad, InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Powerpoint, Excel, Rhino and other modeling software commonly used in the industry . Revit experience is a plus.
The candidate must have a degree in architecture.
